ruling: - **R41. Mods, skills and the output style: keep all, fix seven defects.** Owner 13:36 CST Nov 11: "r41 yes on all". Owner 13:25 CST Nov 11: "tell me how my mods and skills work ... are they even good to keep around anymore, are they under the right folders/locations". Read 13:33 CST (two read-only audits, scratchpad mods-skills-audit.md and decision-watch-audit.md): all 5 mods, 11 skills and shiv-stylisms are in the right folders and earn their place. Decision watch runs in cloud too (167 turns logged in this session). 1. When the given path fails, decision watch finds the transcript by session id. Its UNKNOWN names the path and shows once per session, and so does the silent "no transcript" case. Red cases first: Windows backslash, drive letter, `~`, Git Bash `/c/`, a second config dir, a long folder name. 2. The cloud installer skips `__pycache__` when it hashes a skill, so it stops backing up waiting-page at each start (23 copies, 38 MB here). 3. waiting-page SKILL.md (883 lines) splits by topic and drops its PR history. 4. The rule map counts the reply judge's four style rules; the 20-line hand-off bullet in shiv-stylisms splits. 5. Decision question-form says what the code does: a Departs from line on every question. 6. One stale note and the unused ponytail marketplace go. 7. Owner 13:33 CST: "i also frankly dont see some mods that i do see on local claude like the weather context thing". His screenshot shows the weather band on a local session and none on this cloud one. The mods are installed here and their hooks run (decision watch logs each turn), so the gap is in the drawing. The plugin docs say a cloud session draws in no screen of its own. A lane reads the debug log of one cloud session to find whether the band hook runs and what the app drops. A platform limit goes in a record and upstream; a defect of ours gets fixed. Homes: decision decision-watch-mod-limits; install.sh; skills/waiting-page; lint/rule_mechanisms.json; decision question-form.
